Wohnung

Lage

Sonstiges

Ground-floor apartment featuring an equipped kitchen with an oven, gas stove, dishwasher, and refrigerator.

The bathroom has a window and a bathtub.

The apartment includes a large double bed, a sofa bed, and plenty of seating space.

Please note: Internet access and a washing machine are not provided. However, the necessary connections are available for both. There might be a temporary solution.

Busses and railway tracks run in front of the place - very noisy! The apartment is divided into 2 sections. Bathroom and kitchen are across the staircase.

I am flexible with move-in dates until the 16th of November. Shorter periods are possible, too (but not less than 3 months). I am flexible and happy to help you.

Bus stop Arndtstr. in direction UN Campus.
Bus stop Herz-Jesu-Hof in direction Hbf.
U-Bahn Auswärtiges Amt in direction Bad Godesberg/Ramersdorf.
Welo shared bicycle for free on my behalf.
Less than 10min walk to the river.

Please send me a message, why my apartment could be a perfect match for you. If interested we can make an appointment.

Non-Smokers and single households are preferred.
